edition.locus: Gebhardt II.5-9 (Carpus confesses; the true worshippers)

source_text: Κάρπος εἶπεν· Ἐγὼ Χριστιανός εἰμι, Χριστὸν τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ σέβομαι, τὸν ἐλθόντα ἐν ὑστέροις καιροῖς ἐπὶ σωτηρίᾳ ἡμῶν καὶ ῥυσάμενον ἡμᾶς τῆς πλάνης τοῦ διαβόλου· τοιούτοις δὲ εἰδώλοις οὐ θύω. Ἐμὲ γὰρ ἀδύνατον θῦσαι κιβδήλοις φάσμασιν δαιμόνων· οἱ γὰρ τούτοις θύοντες ὅμοιοι αὐτοῖς εἰσιν. Ὥσπερ γὰρ οἱ ἀληθινοὶ προσκυνηταί, κατὰ τὴν θείαν ὑπόμνησιν τοῦ κυρίου, οἱ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ προσκυνοῦντες τῷ θεῷ, ἀφομοιοῦνται τῇ δόξῃ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἰσὶν μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἀθάνατοι, μεταλαβόντες τῆς αἰωνίου ζωῆς διὰ τοῦ λόγου, οὕτως καὶ οἱ τούτοις λατρεύοντες ἀφομοιοῦνται τῇ ματαιότητι τῶν δαιμόνων καὶ σὺν αὐτοῖς ἀπόλλυνται ἐν γεέννῃ· δίκη γὰρ δικαία ἐστὶν μετὰ τοῦ πλανήσαντος τὸν ἄνθρωπον, τὸ ἐξαίρετον κτίσμα τοῦ θεοῦ, λέγω δὴ τοῦ διαβόλου τοῦ παραζηλώσαντος οἰκείᾳ πονηρίᾳ τοὺς δαίμονας ἐπὶ τοῦτο. Ὅθεν γίνωσκε, ἀνθύπατε, μὴ θύειν με τούτοις.
pass_a_gloss: Carpus said: I am a Christian, I revere Christ the Son of God, the one who came in latter times for our salvation and who rescued us from the error of the devil; but to such idols I do not sacrifice. For it is impossible for me to sacrifice to counterfeit apparitions of demons; for those sacrificing to these are like them. For just as the true worshippers, according to the divine reminder of the Lord, those worshipping God in spirit and truth, are made like to the glory of God and are immortal with him, having partaken of eternal life through the Word, so also those serving these things are made like to the worthlessness of the demons and perish together with them in Gehenna; for it is just justice to be with the one who led astray man, the excellent creation of God, I mean the devil, who by his own wickedness incited the demons to this. Therefore know, proconsul, that I do not sacrifice to these things.
pass_b_english: Carpus said: I am a Christian. I revere Christ, the Son of God, who came in the last times for our salvation and rescued us from the deception of the devil, but to such idols I offer no sacrifice. For it is impossible for me to sacrifice to the counterfeit apparitions of demons, since those who sacrifice to them become like them (Psalm 115:8). For just as the true worshippers, according to the Lord's own divine reminder, who worship God in spirit and in truth (John 4:23-24), are made like the glory of God and live deathless with him, because they have partaken of eternal life through the Word, so also those who serve these idols are made like the emptiness of the demons and perish with them in Gehenna. For it is a just sentence to share the end of the one who led astray man, the choice creature of God — I mean the devil — who by his own wickedness incited the demons to this. Know therefore, proconsul, that I do not sacrifice to these things.

lemmas.gloss: deception, wandering error of the devil
having shared in, partaken of life

choices.why: dative plural object of θῦσαι; κιβδήλοις means debased or false metal, so renders moral falseness rather than mere existence, and φάσμασιν stresses unreal show

choices.term: ἀφομοιοῦνται τῇ δόξῃ / ἀφομοιοῦνται τῇ ματαιότητι
choices.english: are made like the glory / are made like the emptiness
choices.why: present passive of likening in both halves keeps the deliberate parallel between worshippers sharing glory and idol-servants sharing demons' worthlessness

choices.english: for it is a just sentence
choices.why: cognate noun-adjective pair intensifies fitness of sharing the deceiver's ruin, not abstract justice in general

bible_refs.note: οἱ ἀληθινοὶ προσκυνηταί ... οἱ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ προσκυνοῦντες τῷ θεῷ

translator_notes: No edition headers, standalone digits, or obvious OCR debris were present in the locked source; nothing was skipped.
Psalm numbering is uncertain between Hebrew and Septuagint counts; Psalm 115:8 is given in English numbering for the like-them saying.
The clause with παραζηλώσαντος οἰκείᾳ πονηρίᾳ τοὺς δαίμονας ἐπὶ τοῦτο is syntactically obscure; rendered as incitement of the demons without adding Greek.
